issue: What standard of appellate review applies to a challenge to the adequacy of a district court's sentencing explanation: de novo, or abuse of discretion?

sides.position: Review de novo whether the district court adequately explained the chosen sentence
cases: United States v. Davis, 764 F.3d 690, 694 (7th Cir. 2014)
United States v. Upshaw, 918 F.2d 789, 792 (9th Cir. 1990)

sides.position: Review the adequacy of the sentencing explanation for abuse of discretion
cases: United States v. Lynn, 592 F.3d 572, 575-76 (4th Cir. 2010)

quote: And there is a circuit split as to the proper standard of review for this issue.
cite: United States v. Otis Mays, Jr., 993 F.3d 607 (8th Cir. 2021)
